title: cecropia schreberiana subsp. antillarum
intro: Cecropia schreberiana subsp. antillarum, commonly known as Antillean cecropia, is a plant species belonging to the family Urticaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cecropia schreberiana subsp. antillarum include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
